The execution failed because modified paragraphs retained <hp:lineSegArray> elements, triggering a specific layout cache assertion error.
The test failed at 'assert paragraph.find("hp:linesegarray", NS) is None', indicating the script failed to strip layout metadata after text replacement. Trace analysis suggests the regex or XML manipulation failed to target the correct tags or suffered from namespace mismatches. Future attempts must ensure the entire <hp:lineSegArray> block is removed from modified <hp:p> elements to force HWPX viewers to recalculate layout.
